THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Pineapple Ham CocoRolls Snack Box

Snack Box Series Ep. 14 — sweet-and-savory kid snack box: fresh pineapple, Hempler's Black Forest uncured ham, Great Value light mozzarella, and Sun Tropics Salted Caramel CocoRolls. ~230 cal / 17g protein per box. 4 boxes = 2 kids across 2 days.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME10 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~230 cal | ~17g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 2 cups fresh pineapple chunks — 1/2 cup per box
  • 8 oz Hempler's Black Forest uncured ham — 2 oz per box
  • 4 Great Value light mozzarella string cheese sticks — 1 stick per box, cut into bite-size pieces
  • 2 servings Sun Tropics Salted Caramel CocoRolls — 1/2 serving per box

Allergens: dairy, eggs, coconut. Sun Tropics Salted Caramel CocoRolls contain EGG and COCONUT — recheck the label if managing an allergy. Contains pork — Hempler's Black Forest ham is not pork free. Great Value light mozzarella is dairy. Confirm every packaged product label when managing a food allergy — snack box brands drift.

You want a no-cook sweet-and-savory snack box for two kids across two days that still carries real protein. Fresh pineapple (1/2 cup / box), Hempler's Black Forest uncured ham (2 oz / box), Great Value light mozzarella (1 stick / box), and Sun Tropics Salted Caramel CocoRolls (1/2 serving / box). 10 min flat, no cook, 4 boxes at ~230 cal / 17g protein each.

Method

  1. 1.ADD THE PINEAPPLE. Place roughly 1/2 cup fresh pineapple chunks in one compartment of each of the 4 boxes. Cut age-appropriate — smaller for toddlers.
  2. 2.PORTION THE HAM. Fold or cut 2 oz of Hempler's Black Forest uncured ham into one compartment of each box. This is the main protein anchor — ~73 cal / 10g protein per 2 oz.
  3. 3.ADD THE MOZZARELLA. Cut 1 Great Value light mozzarella string cheese into bite-size pieces for each box. ~50 cal / 6g protein per stick — the second protein tier.
  4. 4.ADD THE COCOROLLS. Finish each box with half a serving of Sun Tropics Salted Caramel CocoRolls. Pack whole for maximum crunch. CocoRolls contain egg and coconut — recheck the label if managing an allergy.
  5. 5.SEAL + CHILL. Snap lids on and refrigerate. Serve within 2 days. Transport with an ice pack. For maximum crunch, pack the CocoRolls separately and add them at serving time.

Storage and reheating

Store: Refrigerate covered. Transport with an ice pack for lunchbox use.

Reheat: Don't — serve cold. That's the whole snack-box format.

Lasts: Best within 2 days. Pack the CocoRolls separately and add at serving time if you want maximum crunch.

~230 cal | ~17g protein.

Brands I use

Hempler's
Black Forest Uncured Ham (~37 cal / 5g protein per oz — 2 oz per box)
The mild, kid-friendly protein anchor. 2 oz per box lands at ~10g protein from the ham alone. Uncured, no added nitrates. Verify the current label.
Great Value
Light Mozzarella String Cheese (~50 cal / 6g protein per stick — 1 stick per box)
The second protein tier and the creamy element. Light mozzarella keeps calories down while adding 6g protein per box. Cut into bite-size pieces for younger eaters.
Sun Tropics
Salted Caramel CocoRolls (rolled coconut wafers, ~130 cal / 1g protein per 1 oz serving — 1/2 serving per box)
The sweet crunch that makes it read as a treat box. Rice-flour wafers, gluten-free. Contains EGG and COCONUT — recheck the label if managing an allergy. Pack whole for crunch.
Fresh Pineapple
Any grocery-store fresh pineapple, cut into chunks (~41 cal / 0.5g protein per 1/2 cup)
The bright fresh element and the natural sweetness. Estimated from the filled compartment, not weighed. Cut age-appropriate.
Buluker Snack Containers
Four-compartment pastel snack boxes (the exact set shown across the Snack Box Series).
Same 4-compartment containers used across every Snack Box Series entry. Pineapple, ham, mozzarella, and CocoRolls each get their own compartment. See Favorites → Snack Box Essentials.
